scenes.title: Leafen opens Tailscale
scenes.caption: Leafen opens Tailscale’s login in this computer’s browser. To use your phone, you scan the QR code.

scenes.title: Scan it with your phone
scenes.caption: Your phone’s camera reads the QR code, and you tap the login.tailscale.com link it shows.

scenes.title: Log in to Tailscale
scenes.caption: You log in with an account such as Google, Microsoft, GitHub or Apple. Without one, it’s made here.

scenes.title: Allow the public address
scenes.caption: Then Leafen shows the step that allows a public address; in a browser, you press “Open Tailscale” to open its page. On a phone, you scan the new QR code.

scenes.title: Turn on HTTPS and Funnel
scenes.caption: With HTTPS certificates and Funnel on, you tap the blue button. The address’s name goes into public certificate logs.

scenes.title: Your public address
scenes.caption: In a few seconds Leafen shows the public address, where phones and agents on the internet come in.

shows: What comes next on your phone and in Tailscale
